restrictions: Complete fixed-IV SHA3-256 sponge (rate 1088, capacity 512, suffix 0x06, pad10*1), prefix rounds 0 through 5, all 256 output bits; every message is exactly 64 bytes (one block).

Generic birthday search over N = 255*2^120 messages in 255*2^88 groups of 2^32: group g draws 256 uniform random bits for lanes 0, 1, 2, 5 and sets lanes 3 = 0x06 ^ M64 ^ rotl64(L0 ^ L5, 1), 4 = 0, 6 = 0, 7 = L2 ^ rotr64(L0 ^ L5, 1) to form a 64-byte prefix P_g (so round-1 chi differences satisfy u3 = u4 = v0 = v4 = 0), and message m(g,z) is P_g with LE32(z) XORed into bytes 0..3 and 40..43 (low halves of lanes 0 and 5, one theta column). Groups are processed in batches of 256 (one group per bit position of every 256-bit word, bitsliced), z = gray(t) for t = 0..2^32-1, slots offered in the fixed order decode_slot(q) = 32*(q mod 8) + floor(q/8), q = 0..255. Message (beta, t, q) has number n = beta*2^40 + t*2^8 + q.

Each z-step of a batch (256 messages) is an exact counted, fully unrolled word-RAM program (branches only in the ctz tree, the table step including its candidate path, and the loop test; 32 fused straight-line leaves, no indirect jump) of at most 31,903 executed primitives on its worst path (leaves cost 31,898..31,903): AND-free incremental round 2 on the 22 all-ones support words (0 basis loads, 21 affected chi rows, 554 patched O2P words, 1,896 ops), lane-complement rounds 3-5 with theta at the store and rotating start planes (2, 39, 34), the dependency cones of rounds 4-5 (1,363 and 175 words), the last round on 35 fixed bit planes (140 digest bits at key bits 0..139), a rotating-frame delta-swap transpose with statically zero rows (3,418 ALU ops plus 248 counted loads/stores, 786 executed 256-bit rotations), a 6-op tagged-id table step per message, and loop control. Charge: 31,903/256 + setup (< 2^-20) per message.

Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5 with 64 registers as our stated assumption (the program uses all 64: at most 62 per compiled leaf, register-allocated by interval colouring after SSA and store-to-load forwarding, plus the step counter and the table word c). One six-round permutation costs 1 unit; every executed load, store (direct or register-addressed), logic operation, shift or rotation, add, comparison, conditional branch, immediate move and random word costs 1/1626; constant addresses and immediates are instruction fields. The 64-register reading does not cover a register bank of thousands of words; no bound is claimed under such a reading (a fixed-bank reading would give 123.823; not claimed) or a memory-to-memory reading. Charging also one address addition per direct access and one move per ALU immediate gives 41,343 per z-step and 124.667; also each shift or rotation amount 42,129 and 124.694.

Table: S has 2^140 words at address 0 and is never initialised; the key K < 2^140 is the address; the slot holds TAG*2^128 + n (TAG a uniform 128-bit word drawn once per run). Hot path per message: load, XOR with c = TAG*2^128 + n, compare < 2^128, branch, store c, c += 1. A slot whose high half equals TAG is a candidate: both messages are rebuilt from their numbers and stored prefixes and evaluated in full (2 units); the run halts only on equal 256-bit digests of distinct messages, otherwise it counts the candidate and continues (at most 68 extra ops incl. the jump back; halting step at most 68 ops), aborting at the hard cap VCAP = floor(N^2/2^141) + 2^91 + 2^61. Garbage candidates (never-written words) have expectation <= N*2^-128 for any initial memory.

Time bound in every run (no restarts): T <= N*(31,903/256 + 2^-20)/1626 + VCAP*(2 + 68/1626) + (2 + 68/1626) + 1 < 2^124.29332, proved by an exact integer inequality (proof Section 8). The success probability 0.39 (model value 0.39106) relies on the declared heuristic H1 for F1, F2 and the genuine-candidate part of the abort probability (<= 2^-67); garbage candidates add <= 2^-61 by Markov without heuristic. Output correctness and all resource bounds are unconditional.

No cryptanalytic weakness of SHA3 is claimed: this is a constant-factor improvement of a full-digest birthday search under the operation-level cost model. Memory is about 2^145 bytes (reported only, not a Pareto improvement).

heuristics.statement: For the failure events F1, F2 and the genuine-candidate part of F4 (proof Section 7), the N = 255*2^120 digests of the grouped message set {m(g, z)} (independent structured prefixes P_g with 256 uniform bits per group, all z in {0,1}^32, processed in any fixed order chosen independently of the digests, in particular the order of Section 2: batch by batch, t = 0..2^32-1 with z = gray(t), slots p = decode_slot(q) = 32*(q mod 8) + floor(q/8) for q = 0..255) behave like N independent uniform 256-bit values, i.e. Pr[F1] <= exp(-N(N-1)/2^257), Pr[F2] <= N^3/6 * 2^-396 and, since the 140-bit key is a fixed function of 140 digest bits, the number Y1 of message pairs with equal keys has E[Y1] <= N^2/2^141 and Var[Y1] <= E[Y1].
heuristics.scope: Only the success probability (Section 7) uses H1, through Pr[F1], Pr[F2] and Pr[Y1 >= E + 2^91] <= 2^-67 (Chebyshev). The garbage-candidate part of the abort (<= 2^-61, Markov on E[Y2] <= N*2^-128 with a uniform run TAG), evaluator exactness, verification of every output, and all time, memory and preprocessing bounds are unconditional (the candidate cap makes the time bound hold in every run). Cross-group pairs (all but a 2^-96 fraction of pairs) provably collide with probability >= 2^-256 each (Cauchy-Schwarz over the independent 256-bit group prefixes), so the expected number of colliding pairs is at least (1-2^-96) N(N-1)/2^257 without H1; H1 is needed for the second-moment behaviour behind Pr[F1], for F2 and for Y1. Bitslicing, batching, the incremental round 2, the start planes, the dependency cone, the compiler, the 140-bit key and the fixed encodings change neither the message set nor any digest value; they fix only the processing order, which depends on (batch, t, q) and never on digests.
heuristics.extrapolation: Tested at scale only: four organizer-executed scaled analogues with N_t = 2^9 messages and an 18-bit mask of kept digest bits (N_t^2/2^18 = 1, close to N^2/2^256 = (255/256)^2), all computing digests with an evaluator that mirrors the counted program (AND-free incremental round 2 on 22 all-ones support words; lane-complement rounds with theta at the store and the start planes 2, 39, 34; rounds 4-5 computed in full, then every word outside the Lemma 10 cone replaced by an unrelated constant; last round on the 35 kept planes at the program's low-aligned key rows; the rotating-frame zero-row transpose, checked against the full transpose; processing order; every key also run through the tagged-id table with adversarial garbage): 256 groups x 2, 16 groups x 32, a single group of 512 and 4 groups x 128 with the varying z bits at 25..31. Every organizer trial checks the whole 140-bit key against an independent direct sponge (its first 4 and one at every step t = 2^i), the 22-word all-ones support of each Gray coefficient column, and the incrementally maintained round-3 input against a rebuild. Across the local public, bs3-rv-1 and committee-c1 seed suites (94/103/98/94, 94/100/109/93, 105/97/119/99 of 256) and 1,024 pooled trials per layout (420/387/422/398 of 1,024, z = +1.12/-0.99/+1.25/-0.29; masked-pair variance/mean 0.971/1.049/0.960/1.041), empirical frequencies match the uniform model (Section 10.3). The claim extrapolates uniform-model behaviour to N = 255*2^120, the 256-bit digest and its 140-bit truncation.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is not proved. Within a group the round-2 theta output A2 is exactly affine in z (Lemma 2), with each z-bit flipping 22 words of A2 by all-ones (Lemma 3), a stronger structure than in a generic search; five further nonlinear chi layers (rounds 2-6) follow, but masked low-width experiments cannot exclude a structural effect that appears only at full width. Within a group the digest has degree at most 2^5 = 32 in z; z has 32 bits, so no degree-based zero-sum exists on any affine subspace of z. The experiments use a full dictionary of masked keys, so the table loss F2 and the candidate count Y1 are bounded only under H1. Organizer seeds are public. The scaled experiments resolve the success frequency only to about +-0.03 at 256 trials. The 0.00106 allowance between the model value 0.39106 and the claimed 0.39 is not statistically certified.
